_comment: Plants deliberately taken OFF the monitoring platform.
This is not the same thing as a plant that is quiet. A quiet plant is still
monitored and shows up as CONNECTIVITY / LINK DOWN in the reports. A plant
listed here has been dropped by decision — usually because the customer will
not keep the monitoring link alive after being told it is mandatory.
An excluded plant is skipped by device alarms, production alerts, weekly
customer reports and the admin summary, and every script prints the exclusion
in its log so nobody has to wonder where the plant went.
Matching (see exclusions.py) is on a normalised key — lower-cased with every
non-alphanumeric character removed, so 'Gayan-IMH' == 'gayan imh' == 'gayanimh':
plant    — the data-file key, e.g. 'abeetha-plant' for data/abeetha-plant-2026-09.csv
customer — OPTIONAL account label from credentials.json, e.g. 'Abeetha'.
Excluding a customer excludes every plant key beginning with that
label, plus their device alarms and weekly report.
reason   — REQUIRED free text. It is printed in the logs and the admin summary.
since    — REQUIRED YYYY-MM-DD, the date the decision was taken.
Example entry (copy, do not uncomment this one):
{ "plant": "someone-plant", "customer": "Someone",
"reason": "Dongle offline since 2026-03; customer declined to restore it",
Removing an entry puts the plant straight back on the platform on the next run.
